item: housekeeping lane no longer holds the write gate across network work; gate_hold names the lane (P-A)
summary: Field diagnostics 9931cffe: oo-housekeeping-lane held the write gate 2,933 s, 2,666 s of it between statements, stack in the fetcher. Cause read on main and reproduced red: _lane_step_crawl ended each outlet with a bulk last_crawled_at UPDATE (takes the gate at once) and never committed, so the next outlet's sitemap discovery and page walk ran with the gate held and the fetcher's release declines a session that has written. Now the crawl step commits after each outlet and after a recorded sitemap, rolls back a failed outlet, and run_housekeeping_lane commits after each kind. Each step runs under the fixed pool-watch label lane:<kind>, and the gate_hold closing record reads it (pool_watch.work_label) when no request template exists, so a hold names the lane. Six mutants each turn a test red.
